name: Abr Baran IDC Arak
notes: Operator page (checked 2026-08-11) identifies Abr Baran as a datacenter in Arak, Markazi province offering dedicated/cloud servers, cloud hosting, colocation, GPU servers, 24h support; supporting company article says first and second halls are in Arak. Capacity/MW not disclosed.

name: Markazi Province Gas Company data center
notes: IRIB reported opening of a new data center for Markazi Province Gas Company to improve information security and communications infrastructure. Government/enterprise facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: Parsdev Rasht data center
notes: Parsdev states it provides hosting and datacenter services with physical branches in Rasht and Tehran; DataCenterMap lists Parsdev Rasht on Prophethood Street, Rasht, Gilan. Operator page primary (A for existence), facility address third-party (C); aggregate grade B. DataCenterMap lists Rasht as an Iran market.

name: Mihan Web Host data centers
developer: Net Mihan Communications / Mihan Web Host
notes: Mihan Web Host official page says it launched its first dedicated datacenter in summer 1394 (2015) and now runs five data centers with 200 sq m and 2000-server capacity; provider based in Rasht, Gilan, with multi-location network including Rasht, Tehran, Isfahan, Tabriz. Only the Rasht/Gilan anchor counted here.

name: IranCell Sari / Mazandaran provincial data center initiative
notes: Iranian parliament news agency reported discussions to launch an Irancell datacenter in Sari using provincial fiber capacity; no later completion evidence found in this pass. Planned only.

name: Islamic Azad University Sari data center
notes: ANA reported the Sari IAU data center opened with 200 sq m area, 6.5+ billion rial investment, nominal 40 physical servers supporting 600+ virtual servers, and 50,000+ GB storage. Educational facility; capacity in servers not MW.

name: MCI Tabriz regional data center (largest west/northwest Iran)
developer: Mobile Telecommunication Company of Iran (Hamrah-e Aval / MCI)
notes: ICT ministry page states MCI opened the largest west/northwest datacenter in Tabriz: 3,000 sq m technical area, 250 racks expandable to 350, 1,500 physical servers, 16,000 virtual servers, supporting cloud, network resilience and IX connectivity. Official opening Jun 2020 (A); current operating status should be re-confirmed with MCI.

name: ArvanCloud Shahriar data center (Tabriz)
notes: Zoomit reported ArvanCloud opened the Shahriar data center in Tabriz (its first outside Tehran/center), Tier 3 claim, initially 16 racks with another 16 planned, hosting cloud servers; Arvan network page lists Tabriz presence. Operator self-disclosure for Tier; B grade.

name: Iranfanni IDC Tabriz
notes: DataCenterMap archived listing describes Iranfanni IDC at Tabriz Baghmishe, claimed establishment 2003 with multiple 1G Internet ports, but listing marked no longer active - status may be closed or replaced. C lead only.

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Tabriz
developer: ITO / Iran Cloud program consortium (Asiatech, Zharfnegar, Abr ZS, ArvanCloud, Fanap)
notes: Iran Cloud (abr-e Iran) program: ITO handing provincial datacenter infrastructures in eight provinces to two winning consortia (Zoomit); IRNA reports program unveiled with 2,400 billion toman investment. Tabriz is a named Iran Cloud city. Program-level planned lead - underlying facility/status requires official ITO/ICT confirmation per facility.

name: Maku Free Zone national datacenter hub
developer: Private-sector partner with West Azerbaijan ICT authorities / Maku Free Zone
notes: ICT ministry reported West Azerbaijan ICT director said a fourth national datacenter hub would be created in Maku Free Zone with private-sector participation and 3,000 racks (official announcement, A); article also named Alborz, Fars, Razavi Khorasan as other hubs. No construction evidence found - planned.

name: West Azerbaijan Governorate data center (Urmia)
notes: Donya-e-Eqtesad reported the West Azerbaijan Governorate data center opened in Urmia to aggregate communications for governorate buildings, including fiber, state network, monitoring, web hosting, automation and virtualization. Government facility; historical record (2015).

name: Kermanshah advanced western Iran data center proposal
notes: Mehr reported Kermanshah governor requested creation of a large advanced datacenter in Kermanshah as the best point for western Iran processing/storage. No construction start found - planned/proposed only.

name: First educational data center of western Iran (Kermanshah)
developer: Kermanshah education authorities / smart high school project
notes: Mehr reported the first educational data center in western Iran opened in Kermanshah with domestic high-speed fiber-connected servers and 150 TB storage, supporting virtual classes and online exams. Educational facility.

name: ArvanCloud Gheysar data center (Ahvaz)
notes: Zoomit and Digiato report ArvanCloud launched the Gheysar data center in Ahvaz - its fifth datacenter in Iran and third compute region after Tehran and Tabriz, enabling multi-region architecture for southern/western users. Recent opening (Aug 2026), B trade press; capacity not disclosed.

name: Khuzestan provincial data center (first provincial DC in Iran)
notes: Mehr reported the country's first provincial data center opened in Khuzestan with ~40 billion rial investment by ITO, part of a plan for 18 provincial centers alongside the National Data Center. Government NIN facility; old record, current status should be re-verified.

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Ahvaz
notes: Ahvaz is a named Iran Cloud city (provincial datacenter infrastructures in eight provinces handed to two consortia for cloud operation). Program-level planned lead; underlying facility status requires ITO/ICT confirmation. Distinct from ArvanCloud Gheysar and the 2013 Khuzestan provincial DC.

name: MCI large south Iran data center (Shiraz)
developer: Mobile Telecommunication Company of Iran (Hamrah-e Aval / MCI)
notes: Zoomit reported MCI began construction of a large south-Iran data center in Shiraz with 300-rack capacity (five times the existing Shiraz DC), 1,000 billion toman investment, 18-month target. Completion status not confirmed in this pass - keep construction pending current evidence.

name: Dourbord Shiraz Electronic Tower data center
developer: Dourbord Communications Engineering; Shiraz Electronic Tower / MAGFA
notes: ILNA and Fars report the Shiraz Electronic Tower datacenter opened as the first Ministry-licensed southern Iran data center, ANSI/TIA-942:2017 aligned, implemented by Dourbord with 400+ billion rial investment; phase two was being prepared.

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Shiraz
notes: Shiraz is a named Iran Cloud city. Program-level planned lead; verify underlying provincial facility with ITO/ICT tender or opening evidence before promotion.

name: Arvina Kerman data center
developer: Arvina / Tose'e Pardaz Farzan / NoAyin Technology Group
notes: Arvina official page says its Kerman data center began activity in 1403 (2024-25) with joint investment by Tose'e Pardaz Farzan and NoAyin Technology Group, offering cloud services, dedicated servers, colocation, 24/7 monitoring, UPS backup, 2x10 Gbps fiber uplinks. Commercial colocation.

name: Kerman provincial data center / National Information Network node
notes: ICT ministry (2013) said provincial data centers formed the second layer of the National Information Network and Kerman was among those being prepared/completed. Government NIN facility; current operator status limited - keep operational per official opening-era record with note.

name: Tus Data Center Mashhad
notes: Tus Data Center operator page states it is a Mashhad-based data center offering colocation and dedicated server rental, UPS/generator power, 99.99% uptime claim, direct national backbone connection, BGP/IP announcement, institutional customers in Mashhad/Khorasan Razavi. Capacity/MW not disclosed.

name: Asiatech Mashhad IDC presence
notes: CITNA reported Asiatech expanded IDC services geographically to Tabriz, Shiraz and Mashhad with 2.4+ PB active content storage and 650+ Gbps domestic content traffic; Asiatechin currently advertises colocation in Mashhad (alongside Tabriz, Qom, Hamedan). Mashhad facility existence B; capacity in storage/traffic not MW.

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Mashhad
notes: Mashhad is a named Iran Cloud city; IXP city anchor. Program-level planned lead; underlying facility requires ITO/ICT confirmation.

name: MTN Irancell Isfahan Data Center
notes: DC Byte lists an Isfahan Data Center operated by MTN Irancell as self-build telco facility; Irancell social post referenced new data centers in Karaj, Mashhad and Isfahan with 240 racks. Aggregator + social evidence, C grade pending official Irancell facility page.

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Isfahan
notes: Isfahan is a named Iran Cloud city and IXP city. Program-level planned lead; also ArvanCloud product pages name Isfahan among Iranian datacenter cities (operator self-disclosure).

name: Irancell large National Information Network data center
notes: ICT ministry provincial page says a large data center project was ready for operation/opening, built by Irancell with private investment for National Information Network cloud and infrastructure services. Province-level record (Zahedan area anchor); capacity not disclosed.

name: Kurdistan provincial data center and ICT complex (Sanandaj)
developer: Iran Ministry of ICT / Kurdistan ICT office / Iran IT Organization
notes: IRNA reported start of construction of a Kurdistan (Iran) data center and ICT complex in Sanandaj on a 3,290 sqm site with 7,258 sqm building, planned 18-month completion then equipment by Iran IT Organization. 2017 record; current operational status unconfirmed - keep construction pending later evidence. Persian 'Kurdistan' = Sanandaj, Iran, not Iraqi KRG.

name: Hamadan provincial data center
developer: Iran Information Technology Organization / provincial ICT authorities
notes: Mehr reported Hamadan provincial data center launched as the fourth provincial datacenter, supported by 11 servers, with rental and cloud-computing use available. Government facility; DataCenterMap also lists a Hamedan market. Old record; current status should be re-verified.

name: Hamadan Municipality primary, backup and database data centers
notes: 2026 tender listing shows Hamadan Municipality ICT Organization sought support/maintenance/operation for the municipality's main, backup and database data centers - implies existing operational facilities. C grade (tender-aggregator evidence).

name: Iran Cloud provincial datacenter overhaul - Hamadan
notes: Hamadan is a named Iran Cloud city (Hamedan). Program-level planned lead; underlying provincial facility status requires ITO/ICT confirmation.

name: First provincial data center of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari
notes: Fars reported the province's first data center launched with 8 billion rial investment, ready to provide high bandwidth and servers to agencies and private firms. Government facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: Shahrekord University Data Center
notes: University announcement says the data center opened during Government Week with cooling, fire suppression, backup power, automatic data backup, 200+ TB storage, SAN/NAS, firewall, 70+ virtual machines. Educational facility; capacity in servers/storage not MW.

name: MizbanPack Poldokhtar Data Center
notes: Provider page describes an operating data center in Poldokhtar, Lorestan, branded MizbanPack, with Tier III design claims, colocation/hosting, redundant UPS/generator/chiller and biometric security. Operator self-disclosure, Tier claim unverified - C grade.

name: Lorestan Telecommunication Shahid Rahimi data center (first in province)
developer: Telecommunication Company of Iran - Lorestan region
notes: Local news quotes Lorestan telecom manager saying the province's first data center was in progress with foundation/substructure works started at Shahid Rahimi center. Under construction; capacity not disclosed.
